name: Voltamp Energy SAOG
hq: PO Box 75, Postal code 124 Rusayl, Sultanate of Oman
description: Voltamp Energy SAOG is the GCC's largest power and distribution transformer manufacturer, founded in 1987 with over 90,000 electrical equipment installations across the MENA region. Operating manufacturing facilities at Rusayl and across wholly owned subsidiaries Voltamp Transformers Oman SAOC, Voltamp Power SAOC, and Voltamp Technology LLC, the Group engineers transformers up to 400kV/500MVA alongside medium- and low-voltage switchgear, solar skids, and packaged E-houses for utilities, oil and gas, wind, solar, and green hydrogen projects. Voltamp has aggressively expanded its regional footprint through an 80%-owned transformer manufacturing subsidiary (NTCL) in Saudi Arabia plus dedicated distribution companies in KSA, Qatar, the UAE, and India. Robust order demand and new advanced manufacturing capacity slated for 2027 underpin its multi-year expansion.
highlights: 9M 2026 consolidated revenue rose 3.4% YoY to OMR 53.56M while net profit increased 8.4% to OMR 10.41M, expanding net margin to 19.4%.
Established 80%-owned National Transformers Company Limited (NTCL) in Saudi Arabia alongside regional distribution units in KSA, Qatar, and the UAE.
FY2025 Financial Snapshot: Revenue of OMR 72.95M and Net Profit of OMR 14.34M (Total Assets: OMR 81.67M).
Ownership Registry (mcd.om): 18,033 registered shareholders • Omani 95.1% | GCC 2.6% | Foreign & Arab 2.3% (4 disclosed 5%+ holders).
